checks.name: Inline JavaScript syntax validation
checks.command: node -e 'const fs=require("fs");const h=fs.readFileSync("index.html","utf8");const s=h.match(/<script>([\s\S]*?)<\/script>/);if(!s)throw Error("inline script missing");new Function(s[1]);console.log("PASS: inline JavaScript parses successfully");'

checks.name: Acceptance surface and offline-runtime audit
checks.command: node -e 'const fs=require("fs"),h=fs.readFileSync("index.html","utf8"),r=fs.readFileSync("README.md","utf8");const req=["Sand","Water","Stone","Wood","Plant","Fire","Oil","Ice","Steam","Lava","Salt","Eraser"],controls=["pauseBtn","stepBtn","resetBtn","clearBtn","speedRange","brushRange","materialSearch"],presets=["volcano","terrarium","oilfire","frozen"];const missing=[...req,...controls,...presets].filter(x=>!h.includes(x));if(missing.length)throw Error("missing: "+missing.join(", "));if(/<(script|link|img)[^>]+(?:src|href)=["\x27](?:https?:)?\/\//i.test(h))throw Error("remote runtime reference found");if(!h.includes("contextmenu")||!h.includes("e.shiftKey")||!h.includes("prefers-reduced-motion"))throw Error("interaction/accessibility hooks missing");for(const word of req.slice(0,11))if(!r.includes(word))throw Error("README missing "+word);console.log("PASS: 12 materials, 4 presets, required controls, input hooks, reduced-motion support, documentation, and zero remote runtime references verified");'
checks.details: Verified all required materials, four named presets, controls, right-click and line-paint hooks, reduced-motion handling, material documentation, and absence of remote script, stylesheet, or image runtime references.

summary: A polished, dependency-free Canvas 2D falling-sand laboratory with twelve selectable materials, heat-driven reactions, four deterministic presets, full painting and keyboard controls, accessible status UI, and a reactive volcano attract scene.
